required.quote: All registered active optometrists now or hereafter licensed in the State of New Jersey shall be required to take courses of study relating to the practice of the profession of optometry

period_years.quote: Fifty credits of continuing professional optometric education shall be required biennially

value: at least one credit for educational programs or topics concerning the prescription of hydrocodone, or the prescription of opioid drugs in general, including responsible prescribing practices, the alternatives to the use of opioids for the management and treatment of pain, and the risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction, and diversion
topical_requirements.quote: at least one credit shall be for educational programs or topics that concern the prescription of hydrocodone, or the prescription of opioid drugs in general, including responsible prescribing practices, the alternatives to the use of opioids for the management and treatment of pain, and the risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction, and diversion

available.quote: Any applicant for license to practice optometry, upon proving to the satisfaction of the board that he is of good moral character...and that he has been examined and licensed by the examining and licensing board of another State of the United States...may, in the discretion of the board, be granted a license to practice optometry without further examination

requirements.value: Applicant must be of good moral character, a citizen or declared intention to become one, hold a license from another state with substantially equal standards, or have passed the International Association of Boards of Examiners in Optometry exam; payment of $50 license fee required; academic requirements determined by Commissioner of Education
requirements.quote: upon proving to the satisfaction of the board that he is of good moral character, a citizen of the United States, or has declared his intention to become such a citizen, and that he has been examined and licensed by the examining and licensing board of another State of the United States, and that at the time of the granting of such license the standard of requirements for the license to practice optometry in the State where such license was granted was at least substantially equal to the standard of requirements for such license established by this chapter, or upon proof that he has successfully passed an examination conducted by the International Association of Boards of Examiners in Optometry
